# Webdev Coursework

> Serge Hall's public academic portfolio and Web Development learning portal.

This site documents coursework completed at Santa Monica College and projects built from that learning. It is an independent portfolio, not an official college website.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://webdev-coursework.com/): introduction and selected projects.
- [Coursework](https://webdev-coursework.com/coursework): courses, assignments, labs, and assessments.
- [Projects](https://webdev-coursework.com/projects): project summaries and architecture details.
- [Roadmap](https://webdev-coursework.com/web-developer-path): learning path and technology map.
- [Reference Hub](https://webdev-coursework.com/resources): development references.
- [Code Playground](https://webdev-coursework.com/code-playground): browser-based practice environment.

Access to public pages and automated crawling remain subject to [robots.txt](https://webdev-coursework.com/robots.txt). This file does not grant access to private accounts or permission to use the content for model training.
